release: SEO tool: asks for SCOPE (This page / Whole site) instead of a raw page count; 17 SEO checks as toggles; results lead with indexability and canonical, then titles and descriptions with their values, then structured data. A single-page run no longer reports duplicate-title/duplicate-description as passing — they are declared notApplicable, because comparing across pages is impossible on one page. SITE AUDIT behaviour change: unticking Links now genuinely skips the link crawl instead of running it and discarding the result, so Site Audit is faster for anyone who de-scopes Links.
